I spent a little time bisecting this issue. I think the crash comes from #119708 - it has been quite hard to bisect because the export was broken with a different issue until #124385. The signal 11 crash appears from #124385 onward.

I did ask an AI agent to help and it found that #119708 adds a second global class `DirChanger` in `platform/macos/export/export_plugin.cpp` - [here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/119708/changes#diff-72b5d6bdf8391a9477aca91fe06263335d88623f353c71cc56ffc8bda6102221R1416), and `core/io/dir_access.cpp` already has one. The agent said the wrong destructor is running in `copy_dir`.

```bash
$ lldb -b -o 'disassemble -n "DirAccess::copy_dir(String const&, String, int, bool)"' bin/godot.macos.editor.arm64.san.mono | grep -E 'bl .*DirChanger'
bl 0x10a3b32cc ; DirChanger::DirChanger at dir_access.cpp:478
bl 0x1041c1b68 ; DirChanger::~DirChanger at export_plugin.cpp:1428
```
